name: mirage
text: Short answer: your ParlayAPI Pro key is NOT half spent. ParlayAPI's own account read, which the engine takes every hour, said 72,040 of 100,000 left at 00:10 UTC (about 28% used in a few days). The 43,623 on your screen is the phone's own estimate ('counted here'), and it double-counts: the phone adds its own call counts on top of the engine's. So the bar is wrong, the real balance is better. What did spend credits: mostly props (3 credits a call, about 70% of the use) and, before v1.0.51, your phone scanning Kalshi itself, which also called ParlayAPI. I'm fixing the bar so the phone shows ParlayAPI's own figure whenever any machine has read it, and cutting the NFL reads on days with no game.
